en.headline: Sui and Tang civilisation exhibition at History Museum ends today
en.dek: The free Hong Kong Jockey Club Series show, featuring more than 165 sets of artefacts from Shaanxi and local finds, including 18 national first-class treasures, closes on Monday after a four-month run.
body: The Hong Kong Museum of History’s exhibition “Prosperity and Magnificence – Civilisation of the Sui and Tang Dynasties in Shaanxi Province” ends today after opening in late April.

Jointly organised by the Leisure and Cultural Services Department and the Shaanxi Provincial Cultural Heritage Administration, and sponsored by the Hong Kong Jockey Club Charities Trust, the free show presents more than 165 sets of artefacts selected from 11 institutions in Shaanxi and from local Hong Kong sites. Eighteen sets are national first-class treasures, and nearly half are making their Hong Kong debut.

Highlights include a pure gold casket used to hold Buddhist relics, a painted dancing figure with double-ringed hairstyle reflecting Tang aesthetics, and gilded silverware showcasing high craftsmanship. An education interactive zone continues until 30 November. The museum is at 100 Chatham Road South, Tsim Sha Tsui.

zh.headline: 歷史博物館隋唐文明展今日閉幕
zh.dek: 香港賽馬會呈獻系列「長安萬象——陝西隋唐文明展」免費展出逾165件（套）文物，包括18件國家一級文物，展期至今日結束。
body: 香港歷史博物館「香港賽馬會呈獻系列：長安萬象——陝西隋唐文明展」今日閉幕，展覽自4月下旬開放至今。
展覽由康樂及文化事務署與陝西省文物局聯合主辦，香港賽馬會慈善信託基金獨家贊助，精選來自陝西11個文博單位及香港本地出土的逾165件（套）珍貴文物，當中18件（套）為國家一級文物，近一半藏品首次來港登場。
重點展品包括盛裝佛骨的純金寶函、反映唐代女性審美的彩繪雙環望仙髻女舞俑，以及展現高超金銀器工藝的鎏金銀器。教育互動區則持續至11月30日。博物館位於尖沙咀漆咸道南100號，免費入場。
